faqs.q: Sec. 18-431. - I.P.C. Section 1003.4.2.2, Garages and service stations.
faqs.a:
Section 1003.4.2.2. Garages and service stations,
is hereby amended by amending the last two sentences to read as follows:
"
1003.4.2.2. Garages and service stations.
Parking garages in which servicing, repair, or washing of vehicles is not conducted,
                  and in which gasoline is not dispensed, shall not require a separator, unless the
                  garage drains into the sanitary sewer system. Areas of commercial garages utilized
                  only for storage of automobiles are not required to be drained through a separator,
                  unless the garage drains into the sanitary sewer system."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
